caption: The drawing features a single bird perched on a small, nearly vertical branch, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bird has a side profile facing left, with its head slightly lowered. Its body is primarily colored in shades of dark green and brown, with black on the top and back of the head and extending slightly down the nape. The beak is black, and the eye is small and circular. The wings are detailed with parallel, horizontal stripes of muted green, yellow, and red, bordered by a brownish-red outline. The tail is elongated, tapering downwards and colored similarly to the body, with darker edges. The feet, partially visible, grip the branch and are colored dark brown. There is a handwritten signature in pencil at the bottom left, reading "Charlie Yanijan." The composition focuses entirely on the bird, with no other objects or background elements.
title: Pa. German Toy Bird
